Marmota Vehicle Tester — Terms of Use & Legal Disclaimer

IMPORTANT NOTICE: By enabling or using this software, you acknowledge that it is provided strictly “AS IS” at your sole risk and that the creator and contributors bear zero liability for any consequences arising from its use.

1. Technical Scope & Strictly Offline Operation

Marmota Vehicle Tester is an independent open-source desktop utility designed solely to:

  • Inspect publicly available War Thunder Datamine files (.blkx, .csv) and index them into a local SQLite database (marmota_catalog.db);
  • Configure vehicle presets, primary ammunition belts, and preview ballistic/penetration values offline;
  • Write and update local plain-text mission files inside War Thunder’s UserMissions/ directory and local preset definitions inside content/pkg_local/ for offline Singleplayer Test Flights.

This software operates strictly at the static file level. It NEVER reads, attaches to, injects into, patches, or alters the game executable (aces.exe, WarThunder.app), dynamic libraries, runtime RAM, network packets, anti-cheat drivers (Easy Anti-Cheat / BattlEye), or online multiplayer servers.

You assume 100% of the responsibility and risk for selecting target folders, backing up your personal .blk mission files, reviewing generated files, and complying strictly with Gaijin Entertainment’s End User License Agreement (EULA), Terms of Service, and Fair Play rules.

legal.privacyHtml:
Marmota Vehicle Tester — Local-First Privacy Policy

1. Zero Telemetry & Zero Data Collection

Marmota Vehicle Tester collects ZERO personal information, account credentials, hardware identifiers, usage analytics, crash tracking, cookies, or third-party advertising/telemetry SDKs. Once the offline catalog is downloaded, all search, inspection, and mission editing run locally on your machine.

2. Data Stored Locally on Your Device

The application stores only operational files inside your OS user directory (Windows: %APPDATA% / %LOCALAPPDATA%\MarmotaVehicleTester; macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/MarmotaVehicleTester; Linux: ~/.local/share/MarmotaVehicleTester):

  • config.json: selected interface language, visual theme, consent state, and War Thunder folder path;
  • assets/marmota_catalog.db & assets/datamine/: local SQLite vehicle index and public Datamine definitions;
  • logs/ & webview2/: local rotating diagnostic logs and embedded WebView storage for the private loopback UI (127.0.0.1 protected by a per-session token).

3. User-Initiated Network Requests

No background phone-home connections exist. Outbound HTTPS GET requests occur strictly when you trigger catalog download/updates from public GitHub Datamine mirrors (github.com / raw.githubusercontent.com), load public vehicle icons (staticfiles.warthunder.com), or click external links.

4. Local Support Diagnostic ZIP

When you click Export Support ZIP, a bundle is saved strictly to your local disk with your OS home directory path redacted (<USER_HOME>). Nothing is ever uploaded automatically.
